content: Fully-automatic JSON-Schema-to-form generators (RJSF/react-jsonschema-form, JSONForms) trade customization for speed of generation; their theming systems fight bespoke, polished design systems. For a project requiring rich per-field help text, guided 'pool' array editors, and category tabs, hand-built components driven by schema metadata (using react-hook-form's useFieldArray for array pools) give full design control; RJSF/JSONForms remain valid if faster time-to-market matters more than visual polish.
